speed/128000/explain.text: Here is a detailed, file-by-file explanation of the provided code. These files constitute the **Attention Backend Abstraction Layer** for the vLLM project (specifically the V1 architecture). This layer decouples the high-level model logic from the low-level GPU kernels (like FlashAttention, FlashInfer, Triton, etc.), allowing vLLM to dynamically select the best kernel for a given hardware and mode
